newsitem.title: USA: Fifth Third authorizes additional buy back.
newsitem.headline: Fifth Third authorizes additional buy back.

text.p: Fifth Third Bancorp said on Tuesday that it authorized an additional $250 million to repurchase shares of its common stock over the course of the year.
The company said the authorization is in addition to Fifth Third Bancorp's previously announced approval of share repurchases of odd-lot holdings and share repurchases to fund stock option plans.

President and Chief Executive George Schaefer said, "During this past year we have had strong earnings, continued asset securitization, and the conversion of our subordinated debt to equity, all of which have contributed to high equity levels. We will continue to maintain adequate capital to pursue our growth strategies."
Fifth Third delivered 23 consecutive years of earnings per share growth and its total rate of return to shareholders has averaged 22 percent per year over the last 10 years, it said.
